first_missing_prerequisite: The determinant branch models require an Euler identity with explicit boundary half-ramification and 90/270 corner defects. Published Riemann-Hurwitz/genus and Gauss-Bonnet interfaces carry full AC; prove the needed finite-cell identity locally instead.
scope: Explicit finite cut-cover data and finite adapted cellulations. The existence of such a representation for an arbitrary Whitney class is not assumed or proved.
